title: neto2 v1 in closed loop on the validation links: ten offline arms beside the rule, BBRv3 and expliCCit's released policy
description: exp-net2-offline-point-230 trained expliCCit's memoryless actor offline on neto1 v1 (release exp-net1-point-228, the run in chosen.txt) from the step data of exp-data-net2-steps-222, ten arms: behaviour cloning, IQL, TD3+BC and expliCCit's own loss, with the window set from the believed BDP (bdp) or as a multiplier (mult). Its release holds training diagnostics only. Here every arm runs in closed loop (net2-off-ARM) beside the fixed rule on neto1 v1 (rule-pt) and on net1 v7 (rule-v7, release exp-net1v6-229), both at u = 0.25 until rule-net1point-val.json has chosen u for each, expliCCit's released policy as deployed (third_party/expliccit-models, trained by its authors on their own data) and BBRv3, on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies, campaign seed 21. summary.md scores each controller against BBRv3 and names the best arm (chosen.json); versus-rule-pt.md pairs each controller with the rule on neto1 v1 by link. This is the first look in closed loop at arms that were not tuned: it says which arms deserve a search, and supports no claim about neto2. Validation links only.
prepare: uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/pt" "$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v7" "$IN/m/$(cat "$IN/m/chosen.txt")/net1.pt" --u 0.25; uv run expliccit train import-expliccit third_party/expliccit-models "$OUT/expliccit" --as-deployed; P=(--policy "rule-pt=$OUT/pt/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v7=$OUT/v7/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "expliccit=$OUT/expliccit/policy.onnx"); for a in "$IN"/p/net2-off-*; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$a")=$a/policy.onnx"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s --best net2-off && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-pt
